fields.label: Zoho data centre
fields.description: Exactly one of: com (US, default), eu, in, com.au, jp, ca, sa, com.cn. Lowercase, no spaces. Leave unset for the US data centre. Requests go to the fixed Zoho Recruit host for that data centre (recruit.zoho.<dc>; ca = recruit.zohocloud.ca); no custom host is accepted.

jobs.list.title: List jobs (legacy)
jobs.list.description: List job openings via GET /recruit/v2/Job_Openings mapped into the legacy NormalizedJob shape. Prefer job_openings.list for the dedicated job_opening model.

candidates.list.title: List candidates
candidates.list.description: List candidates via GET /recruit/v2/Candidates. Optional page, perPage, fields, sortBy, and sortOrder. Filters: cvid (custom view id), converted and approved (true, false or both), state (draft or save; sent as $state). per_page is at most 200.

job_openings.list.title: List job openings
job_openings.list.description: List job openings via GET /recruit/v2/Job_Openings into NormalizedJobOpening. Optional page, perPage, fields, sortBy, and sortOrder. Filters: cvid (custom view id), converted and approved (true, false or both), state (draft or save; sent as $state). per_page is at most 200.

applications.list.title: List applications
applications.list.description: List applications via GET /recruit/v2/Applications. Optional page, perPage, fields, sortBy, and sortOrder. Filters: cvid (custom view id), converted and approved (true, false or both), state (draft or save; sent as $state). per_page is at most 200.

candidates.get.title: Get candidate
candidates.get.description: Fetch a single candidate via GET /recruit/v2/Candidates/{id}. Optional fields.

candidates.search.title: Search candidates
candidates.search.description: Search candidates via GET /recruit/v2/Candidates/search. One of criteria, email, phone or word applies (precedence criteria > email > phone > word). Optional converted and approved (true, false or both), page and perPage (max 200). fields is accepted but ignored: it is not a documented search parameter.

interviews.list.title: List interviews
interviews.list.description: List interviews via GET /recruit/v2/Interviews. Optional page, perPage, fields, sortBy, and sortOrder. Filters: cvid (custom view id), converted and approved (true, false or both), state (draft or save; sent as $state). per_page is at most 200.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify connectivity and credentials for the Zoho Recruit connector. With an access token it calls GET /recruit/v2/users?type=CurrentUser on the connection's data centre; without one it returns the static connector status.
